guide.title: How Skimrr works
guide.intro: Two passes over one folder, and nothing leaves this computer.

scan.title: Choose a folder
scan.body: Skimrr reads every photo once, including raw and HEIC, and looks for two things only: copies of the same picture, and shots that missed focus.

review.title: Decide what stays
review.body: Each duplicate group suggests the best original to keep. Click any photo to enlarge it, or pick a different one. The blur threshold is yours to move.

trash.title: Nothing vanishes
trash.body: Before anything moves, you see the whole batch as a grid and can pull photos back out of it. Files go to a local trash you can restore from until you empty it.

guide.privacy: No account. Your photos never leave this computer. Only activation talks to the network, once, then about once a month.

licence.title: Activate Skimrr
licence.body: Scanning and reviewing are free. Moving files to the trash needs a licence: one payment, yours for good, up to 3 devices.
licence.note: The key arrives by email right after purchase. Activation contacts our licence server once; nothing about your photos is sent.
